page_title: BOU 1-1 MCI | Bournemouth v Manchester City 19/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Anthony Taylor after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

90+5' 1 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is the first to get to a rebound and his weak, but precise effort finds its way through the defenders inside the goalmouth into the back of the net, bouncing in off the right post.
90+5' Rodri (Manchester City) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the left post and wastes a promising chance!
90+5' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
90+4' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth). Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90+3' This is a yellow card! Rodri (Manchester City) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' David Brooks (Bournemouth) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game has come to an end for Adam Smith. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lewis Cook (Bournemouth).
89' It is time for a substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is on for Evanilson.
89' David Brooks (Bournemouth) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Gianluigi Donnarumma hadn't made a superb save.
84' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Rayan is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
82' The attendance is 11218.
77' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
76' Substitution. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) has come on for Eli Junior Kroupi.
76' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Jeremy Doku will be replaced by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
76' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
74' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
74' A first-time shot by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
72' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
71' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Gianluigi Donnarumma has no trouble gathering it.

70' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
67' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
64' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Hill (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Savinho (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch so that Antoine Semenyo can be given a rest.
56' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Phil Foden (Manchester City) replacing Mateo Kovacic.
56' That will be all from Bernardo Silva who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rayan Cherki (Manchester City).
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.

53' Evanilson (Bournemouth) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Gianluigi Donnarumma's superb save the ball would have probably ended up inside the left post. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
51' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Rayan (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
47' Djordje Petrovic pulls off a great save to deny Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
41' The linesman raises his flag. Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
39' 1 - 0 Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
37' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
37' The foul by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
33' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
29' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
29' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
29' Rodri (Manchester City) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
28' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
27' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
25' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

24' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
22' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
22' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
21' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Evanilson (Bournemouth) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
14' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
12' A goal, which was scored by Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City), was disallowed due to offside.
9' Good movement by Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
6' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

5' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Djordje Petrovic, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
2' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Evanilson (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' The first half has started.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
